vintage: transport.data.gouv.fr GTFS stop extraction; scheduled frequency around 2026-12-09

lenses.name: Transit stops
lenses.description: Deduplicated public-transport stop points per 10,000 residents. Stops appearing in overlapping GTFS feeds are deduplicated by normalized name and approximately 100-metre rounded coordinates. Stop presence does not measure service frequency, span, speed or reliability, and catalog coverage can vary.

lenses.name: Transit frequency
lenses.description: Scheduled vehicle stop calls on a representative Wednesday, normalized by residents; supplemental feeds use their nearest valid Wednesday when needed. GTFS calendars and exceptions are applied. Consolidated regional feeds are used where available; supplemental local/regional feeds fill other regions, with stops inside consolidated-feed regions and stops outside mapped French territory suppressed to avoid double counting or cross-border contamination. Departments without any usable extracted GTFS stop remain null; cells in departments with extracted coverage but no extracted stop calls are zero. Values measure theoretical supply, not reliability, speed, crowding or actual operations.
